releases.notes:
A small version

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed Ninetails bite has no particles on 1.21.1
- Fixed Ice Fox Blizzard Deactivation bar not disappearing

## Changes
- Ice Fox's Active Skill [Blizzard] will now put out fire in 7.5 blocks range, if `destroy_terrain` is enabled.
- Kitsune & Ninetails' Item Enhancement now has a configurable Upper Limit
> By default it's 255, meaning it is unlimited, and player can get to Sharpness / Smite Level 255 with increasing XP cost.
> To change it, use `/scoreboard player set [Player] thorigins.enchant_lvl_upper_limit [Value]` to set an upper limit
> E.g. set it to 3, will limit Sharpness / Smite level to being enhanced to 4

## Other
Added support for Origins-Legacy, tested with latest version on 26.3 `Origins-Legacy-1.12.20+26.3.jar`.

Note: This version is seldomly tested. Most discrepancies happens with Vanilla Minecraft's own change

The same version might be usable in other versions where Origins-legacy is being used. You can install it as datapack + resource pack to try it out.\
Be aware that the higher versions will use a **different resource pack**, that can be found below.

releases.notes:
Had fun adding power-binded items :3

## Active Skill [Tails Storage] (For Kitsune & Ninetails)

1. The Skill is now unaccessible instead of being removed when transformed to evolutions other than Kitsune / Ninetails. So that the items won't be thrown out everytime you transform
2. Added new Subpower: Kitsune Bless / Ninetails Curse
    > When you have a _certain item arrangement_ in your tail space, they can act as an enhancement table\
    > You can now enhance the item you hold in your mainpaw\
    >
    > For Kitsune, each blessing cost (Item Smite lvl + 1) * 8 XP levels, grant the item Smite level + 1 (No upper limit) and Fortune Level + 1 (capped at 5) and convert a `Totem of Undying` into `Kitsune Talisman`\
    > For Ninetails, each blessing cost (Item Sharpness lvl + 1) * 8 XP levels, grant the item Sharpness Level + 1 (No upper limit) and Looting Level + 1 (capped at 5) and convert a `Totem of Undying` into `Ninetails Talisman`
    >
    > Both Talismans have item powers attached, usable by any players

## Active Skill [Transform]

1. Fixed unable to transform in Fabric 1.20.2 [Found by LoftyLogic]
2. Unlocking of Lightning Fox is now easier:
    > It now has a pity system:
    >
    > - For the first 50 lightning strikes, you still have 1% odds of unlocking the lightning fox
    > - For every subsequent strike, you will roll the 1% an additional time
    >
    > For example:
    >
    > 1. At 51st strike, you will roll 1% **twice**
    > 2. At 100th strike, you will roll 1% **51 times**
3. Added a `tellraw` to show how many times you have been struck by lightning to unlock the lightning fox
4. Unlocking of Fire Fox is now easier:
    > The 2 Advancements about potion effect are no longer counted (Now only 21 advancements are needed)
5. Unlocking of Ice Fox is now easier:
    > Instead of "**18 Overworld biomes where snowfall can happen under building limit**",\
    > it is now "**9 Overworld biomes with \"Frozen\", \"Snow\", \"Ice\" in their name**"

## Active Skill [Karma]

1. Changed "Feed Animal gain Karma" to "Breed Animals gain 2% Karma Value"
2. Breed Animals and Tame Animals gain Karma Value can now be used by Unofficial Forge Origin Port
3. Fixed a bug preventing you from right clicking an entity
4. After unlocking either Kitsune or Ninetails, the Karma progress is locked. However, you no longer need a Dragon Egg to unlock the Karma progress for another karmic evoluition, it is now:
    > Requiring a **Special Items** with a **Nether Star**, then [**Nether Star in offpaw, Special Item in mainpaw, check Karma Progress**]
    >
    > Here are the **_Special Items_**:
    >
    > 1. If you already unlocked **Kitsune** and want to unlock **Ninetails**, you now need [**_Remain of the Beloved_**]\
    >    It is dropped by Killing your own pet. Only if you "Unlocked Kitsune but not Ninetails, and Karma Progress is locked"
    > 2. If you already unlocked **Ninetails** and want to unlock **Kitsune**, you now need [**_Gratitude of the Redempted_**]\
    >    It is dropped by curing a zombie villager. Only if you "Unlocked Ninetails but not Kitsune, and Karma Progress is locked"
    >
    > Both **_Special Items_** are UUID-Locked, meaning you can't ask someone else to share one with you :3
5. Hand-drawn resource bar for Positive and Negative Karma :3
6. Checking Karma will also have a `tellraw` that tells you the current Karma Value

## Ice Fox

1. Fixed Ice Shard and Ice Sheild not working ain 1.20.2 at all [Found by LoftyLogic]
2. When flying with Active Skill [Blizzard], you can now hold sneak against the ground to turn off the skill (In case you don't know how to)

## Fire Fox

1. Heat Laser and Big Laser from Active Skill [Inferno Cannon] will no longer target players with tag `foxie_trust`
2. Fixed Big Laser Damage never applied properly

## Lightning Fox

1. Fixed in 1.21.1 the iron nugget is sometimes not returned if fail to shoot
2. Reduced the exhaustion cost of Become Lightning in 1.21.1

## Kitsune

## General Change
1. Fixed using `/origin gui` doesn't change your origin
2. Added advancements for unlocking all 5 evolutions, with ways to unlock included in the advancement description.

# Ice Fox
Added way to unlock Ice Fox: Visit all 18 Vanilla biomes where snowfall can happen under building limit\
**New Active Skill [Ice Shield]**\
**New Passive Skill [Revontulet]**

## Active Skill [Ice Shard]
1. Ice Shard is made to be invulnerable to avoid accidentally dropping the ice shard item
2. Ice Shard explosion now no longer damages non-living entities

## Passive Skill [Cold Body]
1. You will gain weakness and slowness in High Temperature Biomes and the Nether
2. Made the Frost Walker effect more usable
3. Fixed a mechanics that cause you to experience lag spike every 20 ticks

## Passive Skill [Fluffy*]
1. The freezing nearby mobs effect can now be muted by sneaking
2. The foxes you carry on your head now no longer receive FREEZE from you

# Fire Fox
1. Fixed a bug that causes you to lose temperature quickly forever if you have a tiny bit of snow on you
2. Temperature gained from consuming blaze rod halved: 1000 -> 500
3. Fixed a bug that transforming to other foxes while fall flying causing the [Mute Fall Sound] to not work completely

# Ninetails
1. Soul cost of crafting an experience bottle doubled; 50 -> 100
2. Greatly buffed ways of obtaining soul
> 1. Mob kill: 50 -> 500
> 2. Soul Deprivation Skill: 100 -> 300
> 3. Hitting Cursed mob: 25 -> 100


### 1.21.1:
1. Ice shard explosion now no longer damages hat foxes
2. Break Ice block particles now emitted as intended

releases.notes:
**Big update changed lots**\
**I'm too tired to write a formatted changelog, here is a brief view**

## General
1. Fixed Crashing Bug when doing /reload
2. Changed the element layer's conditions to be client side. It shouldn'tve worked but it did for many versions before..? Now it's according to the standard and idk what difference it made.

## Karma System
1. Fixed the Death clear karma not working in Forge
2. Added 2 more karma sources for Kitsune(Requested by Dajka21): Feed animals + Tame Pets [Not working on Forge]

## Ice Fox
1. Exploding Ice shards are now glowing blue as intended
2. New Active Skill [Blizzard]
3. Changed the ignite key for the ice shards
4. Fixed the freezing completely nullify the target's damage output, instead of a gradient towards 50% reduction
5. Ice shards explosion will extinguish fires (both block and on entities)
6. Slightly boosted ice shard explosion's knockback for funsies
7. If in water / in rain, ice shard replenishing will not have a cooldown.

## Kitsune
1. Boop heal is now usable to entity with full health, and also apply Luck III for 30s
2. Buffed the Boop's damage (3 → 5) to Undead entities
3. Phasing cannot shield against netherite sword now
4. Self glow when the healing aura is activated is only visible to players within 10 blocks

## Ninetails
1. Soul Power: the shift + primary one will also cause 15s of Darkness + Fear effect on entities 30 blocks around 
2. The Curse will also Halve the target's armor point

## Kistune & Ninetails
1. Foxiality: New effect: 50% Bonus xp gain
2. Phasing can no longer pass through what phantom cannot phase through, plus soul sand and soul soil
4. Phasing Damage reduction cannot shield against iron sword / axe now

## Lightning Fox
1. Buffed Electric Beam damage by 2x
2. Greatly increased the cooldown of lightning summoning during the become lightning
3. Buffed Discharge damage
6. Increased the cooldown of discharge by another 5s
7. Might make railgun more usable in server environement?
8. LIghtning bolt struck around you will refresh your active skills' cooldown

## Fire Fox
1. Big laser used to create explosion at the place of using... It has now being fixed to create explosion at laser end point
2. Added a small burst allowing you to go up from ground quickly


**Might've missed some... This whole project is like patching countless holes here and there**\
**See yall next time!** _if there still is..._

* Disable transformation for a certain player by using /resource set [Player] thorigins:thtransform_transformable 0
* Enable by changing 0 to 1

A switch to allow player to continue unlock another evolution if they have unlocked either kitsune or ninetails.\

releases.notes:
Karma System Expanded:\
At any moment you can press X to see your current karma. Positive karma is the golden one, while the negative karma is the blue one
1. Introduced Negative Karma
2. Removed the mooncheck scoreboard, as it is useless. Not affecting any function.
3. Karma Condition -- Mob kill:
- Every Undead mob killed, the Magnitude of current karma will go up by a bit (+0.5%)
- Every Boss Mob (Ender Dragon + Wither + Warden) killed, the Magnitude of current karma will go up by a lot (+20%)
- Every Tamed Mob (Pets) killed, the karma will drop by a lot (-20%)
- Every Other Mob killed, the karma will drop by a bit (-0.5%)
4. Karma Condition - Food Ate:
- Whenever you eat a golden food (Golden Carrot / Apple / E-Apple), the karma will raise by a bit (+2%)

---

New Elementary Fox - Ninetails
Unlock Condition:
Karma reaches -100%

Active Skill [Power Array]\
Choose among all the Active Skills to use

Active Skill [Pounce++]\
From the basis:
1. Reach added 1.15 -> 1.3
2. Cooldown reduced 1.5s -> 1.0s
3. Jump Limit before landing 2 -> 10
4. Pounce Damage Bonus Base Increased (*1.5) 0.5 -> 0.75
5. Magnetoreception-Enhanced Pounce Damage Bonus Base Increased (*2)
6. Combo will reset main pounce now
7. Exhaustion decreased (/5)


Active Skill [Wraith Form]\
Same as Kitsune's [Yūrei Form], but:
1. Drains [Souls] instead
2. Move about 3/2 times faster
3. Damage reduction is -25% only

Active Skill [Tail Pouch]\
Same as Kitsune

Active Skill [Soul Power]\
This skill includes:
1. An active ability, drains soul, shoot out a 15 blocks beam, dealing 8 magic damage and apply some effects. CD = 5
2. An active ability, drains soul, give yourself strength, resistance, speed, haste,luck
3. An active ability, damage the mob you interact with, give them effects and give your soul
For the soul system:
1. It is retained across transformation
2. You get some soul from killing any mobs
3. You get a little bit of soul constantly by standing under sky

Active Skill [Hunt++]\
From the basis:
1. Hunt Duration Increased 5s -> 10s
2. Extra Strike Change:
- Apply an additional effect of Darkness for 2.5s
- Delt Damage increased 3 -> 5
- Hunt phase prolong increased 1.5 -> 2.5
- Saturation and foodpoint feed increased 2 -> 4
- Heal 1 heart
3. Damage bonus is always midnight
4. Damage bonus base * 2
5. During Hunt, all incoming damage reduces by 25%
6. Sense effect will continue until hunt is over

Active Skill [Foxify]\
Same as default fox

Passive Skill [Agility++]\
Same as other elementary foxes


Passive Skill [Foxiality++]\
From the basis:\
Night Vision Strength 0.5 -> 1.0

Passive Skill [Fluffy]\
Same as default fox

Passive Skill [Smol]\
Same as default fox

Passive Skill [Unique Taste]\
Same as default fox

Passive Skill [Timidity++]\
From the basis:\
No longer fear wolves and polar bears

Passive Skill [Weak++]\
From the basis:\
Being able to wear any armors now

So, you can say Kitsune and Ninetails are two opposite.\
Kitsune requires you to stay peaceful and healthy, while Ninetails requires you to murder everything even people's pets\
Or even your own ones. You can unlock ninetails on Day 1, if you tame 5-6 wolves and kill them the next instant ;(

And the abilities of ninetales are more focusing on combat as well. You can get some very smooth pounce killing streak, easier than the default fox.

So yeah that's it, in a nut shell:\
Want to be healer / supporter, want mobility and feeling of peace? Do not kill anything\
Want the opposite? Kill everything you see\

_**You can't go back if you unlocked either one of them**_
